title: A test m-form with coefficient norm ‖h‖|φ| whose exterior derivative evaluates to Dφ(h)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, φ : ℝ^n → ℝ a C^∞ function with compact support, and h ∈ ℝ^n. Then there is a test m-form ω ∈ D^m(ℝ^n) (TestFormOn univ m) with two properties. First, covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ ‖h‖·|φ(x)| for every x. Second, for every x the exterior derivative dω (= exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ m ω) satisfies dω(x)(e_0, …, e_m) = Dφ(x)(h), where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 and Dφ(x) = fderiv ℝ φ x.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (φ : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (h : Eucl (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) m, (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) m) x) ≤ ‖h‖ * |φ x|) ∧ ∀ x, ((exteriorDerivativeTestOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) m ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)) : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ φ x h
